notes:
Founder-led inbound. Met with co-founder (Evan Park) — demo was lightweight, mostly Q&A. They are building a niche personal productivity app that summarizes user notes and provides inline suggestions. Wants to keep inference in public cloud (no VPC right now).

Founder comments: "We need sticker-price comparisons — per-1k tokens, per-embedding pricing, and what throttles look like." Wants to understand cost delta vs OpenAI/Anthropic when batching and with caching.

Important: pricing sensitivity high. If hosted API is within ~30% of OpenAI baseline they will try a migration test. Mentioned caching + small-quant model suggestions could help.

Security: basic SSO for admin console (SAML) + audit logs requested. Not asking for SOC2 yet but will ask if moving to dedicated.

Notes from call: quick trial signup already completed; they ran a simple v0 integration and saw higher latency than expected on long-context chat (they used default model). Suspect need for guidance on model selection and streaming. Asked about per-route quotas and burst behavior.

AE impression: good fit for self-serve Hosted API; small deal size but high potential to scale if product-market fit. Follow-up should be focused: clear table of prices, burst policy, and recommended model + prompt-level batching guidance.

Quotes / quick snippets recorded in Fireflies: "If we can get predictable unit cost, we'll convert 3 teams."
